text:
maria: Quick favor — can someone run a smoke bench + profile for lynx-7b-v2 on cuda-prod-3? Need p50/p95, tokens/sec, and peak GPU mem. Use seq=1024, batch=1. Cold + warm (prefix=128).

noah: I can kick this off in ~15m. Do you want a quantized pass too or just fp16 for now?

maria: Start with fp16 only for the smoke. We'll do 4-bit quant later if the numbers look sane.

devon: Note: skip aggressive kernel tuning for the first run so results are comparable to our standard baseline. I'll tail logs.

bench-bot: Started job: bench-1835001234-lynx (user=maria) on cuda-prod-3. Config: model=lynx-7b-v2 seq=1024 batch=1 fp16 cold_then_warm prefix=128.

bench-bot: Running cold-run (kv-cache cold). ETA ~3m.

bench-bot: Cold-run complete. Uploading artifacts...

bench-bot: RESULTS (cold, kv-cold):
```
p50_latency_ms: 462
p95_latency_ms: 792
tokens_per_sec: 115
peak_gpu_mem_mb: 13520
notes: single-stream, no extra batching
```

bench-bot: Warm-run (kv-warm, prefix=128) complete.

bench-bot: RESULTS (warm, kv-warm):
```
p50_latency_ms: 118
p95_latency_ms: 262
tokens_per_sec: 410
peak_gpu_mem_mb: 13840
```

sophia: Nice numbers. Cold p95 under 800ms — acceptable for initial onboard. Warm throughput looks healthy.

maria: Agree. devon, you saw any outliers in the logs?

devon: I noticed a couple of spikes ~910ms in one of the cold iterations (single sample), added a short trace: https://benchdash.internal/trace/1835001234 — looks like a kernel compile fallback on run #5. Not consistent.

noah: Good catch. I'll add a checklist item to re-run with compile-cache warmed and with the latest kernel patch. Also scheduling a follow-up quant run next week for 4-bit eval.

bench-bot: Artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-bench/artifacts/1835001234/lynx7bv2/smoke.tar.gz and traces at /traces/1835001234.

maria: Thanks everyone. I'll create the onboarding PR to publish these numbers to the bench dashboard and mark the model as "onboard: smoke-passed". If no objections, I'll also open a card for the 4-bit quantization experiments. :tada:

sophia: no objections from me.

devon: SGTM. Add a note to check p95 under variable batch workloads later.

maria: Will do. Closing thread.

bench-bot: Job bench-1835001234-lynx finished (status=success).
